mapping_notes: A cost-of-delay case in Reinertsen's sense: each initiative starts delivering value (cost savings or margin) sooner, worth a stated amount per week when live. Our 'decision' is one initiative and 'days to decide' is its elapsed development time; this is cycle time, not an approval decision, so the label is looser than the catalog's.

Two engine runs, summed: 16 cost-savings initiatives at $10,000 per week, and 8 revenue initiatives at $40,000 per week x 8.5% operating margin = $3,400 per week. Weekly values are divided by 7 for the per-day input and 16 weeks is expressed as 112 days.
The reduction ramp 25% / 30% / 30% is carried by adoption_by_year = 83.33 / 100 / 100 with days saved set at the Year 3 level (33.6 days = 4.8 weeks).
